# Workflows exempt from the repository-gating check in
# validate-workflow-gating.sh. One basename per line.
#
# The bar for adding a line here is high. A workflow belongs on this list only
# if every repository running it is *meant* to run its publishing steps, and the
# decision about where the artifact goes is genuinely made elsewhere. In almost
# every other case the fix is a `github.repository` gate on the step, or the
# `enable=` expression of the image target, not an entry here.
#
# Note that being a reusable workflow is not by itself a reason: build.yml is
# called from several places on purpose, but it is also the file that
# decides which registries an image is pushed to, so it is checked.
#
# Format: one workflow basename, with a comment above it giving the reason.
